status_at_freeze: No new AlphaMissense or experimental variant outcome opened for this rule
hypothesis: The same cysteine replacement has a greater mean damaging effect at verified structural-disulfide endpoints than at matched, experimentally verified free cysteines in comparable native contexts.
score_direction: Explicitly supplied; all audit outputs oriented higher-is-damaging
estimand: Mean matched-site difference in the identical substitution, bonded minus free; pairs averaged within family, then families equally weighted

matching.continuous: absolute difference in relative solvent accessibility
matching.algorithm: Deterministic smallest-distance-first matching without replacement, using annotations only

eligibility.reference: Native Cys in an accession-specific canonical sequence with its SHA-256 pinned
eligibility.bonded: Direct experimental bond evidence, canonical partner coordinate, structural role independently reviewed
eligibility.free: Explicit experimental evidence of an unbonded thiol in the relevant native context; no bond annotation is not negative evidence
eligibility.structural_annotation_alone: Does not prove the bond is functionally important or its loss pathogenic

uncertainty.unit: homology family, preserving all paired sites and bond endpoints
uncertainty.note: A feasibility threshold, not a claim of adequate power; report interval and individual-family effects

data_roles.assignment: Explicit accession/family-level role; every member of a family has the same role
data_roles.previous_exposure: Union of fitted/exposed manifest roles and earlier Phase C exposure, including INSR and LDLR
data_roles.outcome_access: Fail closed before reading score files if matched eligibility or exposure gates fail

correction.scope: Only the explicitly calibrated Cys replacement at verified structural-disulfide endpoints
correction.strength: Nonnegative, fitted on calibration families only; zero if the declared contrast already passes
correction.target: Explicit positive raw-score margin on the predictor's declared scale; not converted from a physical energy
correction.prerequisite: Expected contrast independently validated in a relevant measured experimental endpoint
correction.preserve: Unchanged variants outside the declared rule scope
correction.success: Held-out paired experimental improvement with uncertainty; passing a constructed rule statistic alone is insufficient

reporting: No universal clinical-law claim; no AlphaMissense failure or successful repair is presumed. Passes, exclusions and blockers are retained.
